title: Read a name from the path
summary: Django: Read a name from the path. Visit /hello/Asha/.
introduction: The str converter passes one path segment as text. Open GET /hello/Ravi/.
learningObjectives: Read a name from the path with Django

blocks.text: Install django~=5.2, run django-admin startproject school, then enter school. Replace school/urls.py with each example and run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. These view examples need no database tables.
Read a name from the path

blocks.title: Read a name from the path

blocks.text: The str converter captures Ravi. A text/plain response displays the characters without treating them as HTML.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use text/plain or proper escaping when returning user text.
